purpose: Teach: 船橋/府中/松村/岡部/江田/栗原/角田/板橋

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 船橋支店のキャンペーンを企画しましょう
lines.en: Let's put together a campaign plan for the Funabashi branch.
lines.style: Crisp, task-focused opening. Slight forward lean in the voice. Efficient tone, no hesitation. The rhythm of someone moving through a checklist with purpose.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。府中事業所の月次報告を確認します
lines.en: Got it. I'll review the Fuchu office's monthly report.
lines.style: Immediate, responsive agreement. Efficient note-taking energy. Clear and direct without being clipped. The tone of someone already mentally pivoting to the next task.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 松村部長の歓迎会を準備しましょう
lines.en: Let's arrange a welcome gathering for Director Matsumura.
lines.style: Same brisk tempo, delegating smoothly. Slight lift at the end—not a question, but an invitation to move forward together. Clear directive without commanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。岡部課長の引き継ぎ書を確認します
lines.en: Understood. I'll check Manager Okabe's transition notes.
lines.style: Confirming nod in the voice. Steady, reliable tone. No flourish—just the quiet assurance of someone who writes things down and follows through.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 江田技術主任のプロジェクト進捗を共有しましょう
lines.en: Let's share the project progress from Eda, our tech lead.
lines.style: Same steady pace, collaborative framing. 'Share' carries a slight weight—this matters to the team. Calm authority without pushiness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。栗原広報の月次企画書を確認します
lines.en: Understood. I'll gather Kurihara's PR monthly plan for review.
lines.style: Repetition of acknowledgment feels natural now—a rhythm built between them. Slightly efficient, but warmed by the established pattern. No strain.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 角田人事に新人研修プランを依頼しましょう
lines.en: Let's request a new-hire training plan from HR—Kakuda's the person.
lines.style: Same directive energy, but a touch of ownership creeping in. Still brisk, but with just enough personality to suggest she knows her team well.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。板橋法務に新契約レビューを依頼します
lines.en: Got it. I'll ask Legal—Itabashi—to review the new contracts.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slightly fuller than before. A closing note to the sequence. Assured and complete. The slight exhale of wrapping up a productive exchange.
